title: burst_stats records (analysis/bursts.jsonl)
description: One record per closed epoch-aligned interval (default 60 s) from the analyzer's `bursts` plugin (analysis/bursts.py): metadata that discriminates hypotheses about impulsive 6-16 kHz bursts (unit electronics or housing ticks, insects, a nearby periodic device): fine 1 kHz sub-band levels, an impulse detector with its inter-impulse gap histogram, modal gap and regularity, the envelope modulation rate, and how the impulses spread over the 8 beams. Windows the tagger flagged as speech (or that no tagger verdict covers while the tagger runs) are excluded and counted. Metadata only; no audio is ever stored. Receivers MUST ignore unknown fields and skip a record whose `v` they do not know.

pct3.description: [p10, p50, p90] or null when there is no sample

t0.description: Interval start, Unix seconds, a multiple of interval_s. A window belongs to the interval holding its midpoint.

partial.description: Present (true) only for the interval flushed at shutdown or begun late; other records carry no `partial` key.

tagger.description: true: the speech tagger was running, so every used window was covered by a non-speech tagger verdict. false: no tagger ran, nothing could be excluded.

win_speech.description: Windows excluded: overlapped a tagger window flagged speech.

win_unvetted.description: Windows excluded: tagger on but no verdict covered them.

win_dead.description: Windows excluded: zero-filled or lost audio (peak below -140 dBFS).

bands_db.description: Per 1 kHz band 6-7 ... 15-16 kHz (10 values), the p10 / p50 / p90 over the used windows of the band power of the beam mean, dBFS; null without a used window.

ref_2_6k_db.description: p50 over the used windows of the 2-6 kHz band power of the beam mean, dBFS (the quiet reference).

within3_hist.description: index i: impulses with i+1 of the 8 beams within 3 dB of the loudest beam

loudest_beam_hist.description: index i: impulses whose loudest beam is beam i+1

beams_hit_hist.description: index i: impulses for which i of the 8 beams are themselves an impulse within +-1 ms

coincident_all_n.description: impulses on which all 8 beams fired within +-1 ms (= beams_hit_hist[8])

n.description: number of gaps = impulses - 1 (0 without impulses)

hist.description: 30 log-spaced bins, edge i = 0.005 * 6000^(i/30) seconds (5 ms .. 30 s)

s.description: seconds of envelope in the spectrum (runs of at least 10 s)
